comment: Param 0 is labelled SWARM on the panel and tooltipped Swarm length, and param 1 is labelled THICK and tooltipped Swarm thickness. In the code param 0 sets the number of past positions held in each trail and param 1 sets how often a position is added to it. The maker's documentation describes the pair the other way round, so each line carries a clause naming the conflict. The X and Y inputs are read only when no Genie is attached to the left; with a Genie attached the display is drawn entirely from the Genie's pendulums. Color Node 3 and Color Node 4 have an effect only in that jack-driven mode, where up to four nodes can be drawn; a Genie feeds two.
